pairs.prompt_text:
I need to understand the testing patterns in the ESI.ts project at D:\code\ESI.ts to plan new tests. Please investigate:

1. Look at the test file structure under tests/tdd/ and tests/bdd-scenarios/ - what patterns exist?
2. Read a representative TDD test file (e.g. tests/tdd/core/ETagIntegration.test.ts or similar) to understand the test setup pattern (imports, mocks, structure)
3. Read a representative BDD test file (e.g. tests/bdd-scenarios/core/bdd-etag-caching.test.ts) to understand the BDD test pattern
4. Check if there are any existing tests for BatchRequestHandler or the type generator script
5. Look at how ApiRequestHandler tests mock fetch and cache behavior

I need to understand enough to plan tests for:
- The spec-aware cache bypass (trySpecAwareCacheHit in ApiRequestHandler.ts)
- The batch request handler (BatchRequestHandler.ts)
- The type generator idempotency
